This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the [[Generation I|first generation]] game {{v2|Yellow}} for the [[Game Boy]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[Game Freak]]. All names are given in Western order.
